name: en: Roasted Groundnuts (Peanuts) local_name: Njugu za Kukaanga
description: Fresh, raw peanuts roasted in a dry pan or sand until perfectly crunchy, deeply aromatic, and lightly salted. A quintessential Ugandan snack enjoyed by all.
instructions: step_number: 1 instruction: If using peanuts in their shells, no preparation is needed. If using shelled raw peanuts, you can optionally create salted nuts by dissolving 1 tsp of salt in 1 tbsp of water, tossing the nuts in this saline solution, and then draining them before roasting. This helps the salt stick. action: preparing ingredients: ing_raw_groundnuts, ing_salt, ing_water
step_number: 2 instruction: Place the raw peanuts (in shells or shelled) in a large, dry, heavy-bottomed pot or skillet. action: combining utensils: utn_heavy_pot_skillet

step_number: 3 instruction: Roast over low to medium heat. Stir constantly with a wooden spoon to ensure even roasting and prevent burning. This is crucial. action: roasting utensils: utn_wooden_spoon cooking_indicators: visual: Shells will darken significantly and may get charred spots. For shelled nuts, they will turn a light golden brown. time: 15-20 minutes texture: They are done when you hear a consistent crackling sound and they smell deeply nutty and toasted. A test nut should be crunchy, not soft or chewy.

step_number: 4 instruction: Once roasted, immediately transfer the peanuts to a large tray or baking sheet to cool. Spreading them out stops the cooking process. action: cooling utensils: utn_baking_sheet
step_number: 5 instruction: If you did not pre-salt shelled nuts, you can sprinkle them with salt while they are still warm and toss to coat. action: seasoning ingredients: ing_salt
step_number: 6 instruction: Allow the roasted groundnuts to cool completely. They will become crunchier as they cool. action: resting
step_number: 7 instruction: For peanuts in shells, serve them in a bowl for people to shell themselves. For shelled peanuts, serve in a bowl or a traditional paper cone (ekikapu). action: serving

name: en: Roasted Sweet Potatoes local_names: Lumonde omyokye, Sweet potatoes (local varieties)
description: Crisp-edged, tender-roasted sweet potatoes seasoned simply with oil, salt and warm spices — served as a snack, side dish, or part of a meal.
ingredients: vegetable oil or sunflower oil (2 tbsp)
paprika or mild chili powder (optional) (1/2 tsp)
fresh lime or lemon (optional, for serving) (1)
honey or brown sugar (optional, for glaze) (1 tsp)
instructions: step: 1 instruction: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Line a baking tray with parchment paper or lightly oil it.
step: 2 instruction: Scrub sweet potatoes thoroughly. Leave skins on for texture and nutrients, or peel if preferred. Cut into wedges or 2 cm-thick slices for even roasting.
step: 3 instruction: In a mixing bowl, toss sweet potato pieces with oil, salt, pepper and paprika (if using) until evenly coated.
step: 4 instruction: Arrange pieces in a single layer on the tray, leaving space between pieces so they roast rather than steam.
step: 5 instruction: Roast for 30–40 minutes, turning once halfway through, until edges are golden and centers are tender when pierced with a fork.
step: 6 instruction: If using, toss the hot potatoes with a small knob of butter or a drizzle of honey to glaze. Squeeze fresh lime or lemon over before serving for brightness.
step: 7 instruction: Serve hot as a snack or side with stews, grilled meats, or salads.

name: en: Sim Sim Balls (Sesame Balls) local_name: Nkate Balls / Sim Sim Kongolo
description: A crunchy, sweet, and highly nutritious energy snack made from toasted sesame seeds (sim sim) bound together with sugar or honey. These dense, brittle-like balls are a powerhouse of energy and a traditional treat.
instructions: step_number: 1 instruction: Toast the sesame seeds in a dry frying pan over medium-low heat for 3-5 minutes, stirring constantly, until they are fragrant, lightly golden, and make a popping sound. Be careful not to burn them. Transfer to a bowl and set aside. action: toasting_seeds ingredients: ing_sesame_seeds utensils: utn_frying_pan

step_number: 2 instruction: If using peanuts, lightly roast them in the same pan if they are not already roasted. Chop them coarsely and mix with the toasted sesame seeds. action: preparing_nuts ingredients: ing_peanuts

step_number: 3 instruction: In a heavy-bottomed saucepan, combine the sugar and water. Heat over medium heat, stirring continuously until the sugar dissolves completely. action: dissolving_sugar ingredients: ing_sugar, ing_water utensils: utn_heavy_saucepan, utn_wooden_spoon

step_number: 4 instruction: Once the sugar has dissolved, stop stirring. Add the lemon juice (if using) to prevent crystallization. Let the syrup boil without stirring until it reaches the hard crack stage (approx. 150°C / 300°F). Alternatively, test by dropping a small amount into a cup of cold water; it should form hard, brittle threads that snap. action: making_syrup ingredients: ing_lemon_juice cooking_indicators: visual: The syrup will become clear and thick, with large, rolling bubbles. temperature: 150°C / 300°F texture: Hard and brittle when tested in water.

step_number: 5 instruction: Immediately remove the syrup from the heat. Quickly stir in the vanilla extract (if using), then immediately pour the hot syrup over the toasted sesame seeds and peanuts. action: combining ingredients: ing_vanilla

step_number: 6 instruction: Working very quickly while the mixture is still hot and pliable, stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until all the seeds are thoroughly coated with the sugar syrup. action: mixing utensils: utn_wooden_spoon

step_number: 7 instruction: Lightly grease your hands with oil or water. Take small handfuls of the hot mixture and press firmly into tight, compact balls, about the size of a golf ball. Act quickly as the mixture will harden as it cools. action: shaping cooking_indicators: visual: The mixture will be glossy and sticky. texture: Firm and moldable when hot.

step_number: 8 instruction: Place the shaped balls on a baking sheet or tray lined with parchment paper or a banana leaf. Allow them to cool completely and harden at room temperature. action: cooling utensils: utn_baking_sheet, utn_parchment_paper
step_number: 9 instruction: Once completely cooled and hardened, the sim sim balls are ready to eat. Store in an airtight container at room temperature. action: storing_serving

name: en: Sour Milk with Groundnut Paste local_name: Bongo mu Binyebwa
description: A rich, creamy, and uniquely flavored dish made by blending thick, fermented sour milk with a smooth, savory groundnut paste. The tangy, sharp notes of the sour milk are beautifully balanced by the nutty, earthy richness of the groundnuts, creating a thick, protein-packed sauce or paste that is both refreshing and deeply satisfying. It can be served as a thick drink, a dip, or a sauce.
instructions: step_number: 1 instruction: Scoop the thick sour milk (Bongo) into a mixing bowl. action: preparing_base ingredients: ing_sour_milk utensils: utn_mixing_bowl

step_number: 2 instruction: Add the groundnut paste to the bowl. If the paste is very thick, you can warm it slightly to make it easier to mix. action: adding_groundnut ingredients: ing_groundnut_paste

step_number: 3 instruction: Using a whisk or a strong wooden spoon, vigorously mix the two ingredients together until they are completely smooth, well-incorporated, and no streaks of groundnut paste remain. action: whisking utensils: utn_whisk
step_number: 4 instruction: Taste the mixture. Add a pinch of salt and/or a teaspoon of honey/sugar if desired, and mix thoroughly again. action: seasoning ingredients: ing_salt, ing_honey

step_number: 5 instruction: The consistency should be thick and creamy, like a smoothie or a runny pudding. If it is too thick for your liking, you can thin it with a very small amount of fresh milk or water. action: adjusting_consistency
step_number: 6 instruction: Serve immediately. The mixture can be drunk, eaten with a spoon, or used as a dip. action: serving

name: en: Flavorful Spiced Bean Stew local_name: Ebijanjaalo Eby'Ennyoogera
description: A rich, aromatic, and deeply satisfying bean stew where tender beans are simmered with a flavorful blend of onions, tomatoes, garlic, ginger, and traditional spices. This elevated version of boiled beans transforms the humble legume into a complex and hearty dish with layers of savory, spicy, and aromatic flavors that make it a standout meal on its own.

instructions: step_number: 1 instruction: Sort and rinse the beans thoroughly. Soak in water for 4-6 hours or overnight for faster cooking. Drain before using. action: preparing_beans ingredients: ing_dry_beans, ing_water
step_number: 2 instruction: Heat cooking oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat. action: heating_oil ingredients: ing_cooking_oil utensils: utn_large_pot
step_number: 3 instruction: Add chopped onions and sauté until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. action: sauteing_onions ingredients: ing_onions

step_number: 6 instruction: Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 5-7 minutes until they break down and form a thick, fragrant sauce. action: cooking_tomatoes ingredients: ing_tomatoes
step_number: 7 instruction: Add the drained beans to the pot and stir to coat them with the spiced tomato mixture. action: adding_beans ingredients: ing_dry_beans
step_number: 8 instruction: Pour in 6 cups of water and bring to a boil. Then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 hour. action: initial_simmering ingredients: ing_water

step_number: 10 instruction: When beans are tender and the stew has thickened, stir in coconut milk if using. Simmer for another 5 minutes. action: adding_creaminess ingredients: ing_coconut_milk cooking_indicators: texture: Beans should be very tender and the stew should be thick and creamy

step_number: 13 instruction: Serve the flavorful spiced bean stew hot. action: serving

name: en: Stir-Fried Black Bean Sprouts local_name: Maharage Meize Meize
description: A quick, crunchy, and highly nutritious stir-fry featuring fresh black bean sprouts, tossed with vibrant vegetables and a savory sauce. This dish highlights the fresh, earthy flavor and crisp texture of the sprouts.
instructions: step_number: 1 instruction: Rinse the black bean sprouts thoroughly in a colander and drain them well. Excess water will make the stir-fry soggy. action: preparing_sprouts ingredients: ing_black_bean_sprouts utensils: utn_colander

step_number: 2 instruction: Prepare all vegetables: thinly slice the bell pepper, julienne the carrot, chop the spring onions (keeping white and green parts separate), mince the garlic, and grate the ginger. action: prepping_vegetables
step_number: 3 instruction: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until very hot. action: heating_wok ingredients: ing_vegetable_oil utensils: utn_wok_large_skillet

step_number: 4 instruction: Add the white parts of the spring onions, minced garlic, and grated ginger. Stir-fry for 30 seconds until very fragrant. action: sautéing_aromatics ingredients: ing_spring_onions, ing_garlic, ing_ginger utensils: utn_wooden_spoon_spatula

step_number: 5 instruction: Add the sliced carrot and bell pepper. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until they just begin to soften but are still crisp. action: cooking_vegetables ingredients: ing_carrot, ing_red_bell_pepper
step_number: 6 instruction: Add the well-drained black bean sprouts to the wok. Toss everything together quickly. action: adding_sprouts ingredients: ing_black_bean_sprouts

step_number: 7 instruction: Pour the soy sauce and sesame oil over the sprouts. Season with salt and black pepper. step_number: 8 instruction: Remove from heat immediately. Stir in the green parts of the spring onions. action: finishing ingredients: ing_spring_onions
step_number: 9 instruction: Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with toasted sesame seeds. action: garnishing ingredients: ing_sesame_seeds
step_number: 10 instruction: Serve immediately while hot and crisp. action: serving

name: en: Stir-Fried Dodo Rice local_name: Mchele wa Dodo
description: A quick, nutritious, and delicious one-pan meal where leftover rice is stir-fried with tender amaranth greens (dodo), vegetables, and aromatic spices. It's a fantastic way to create a complete and flavorful dish from simple ingredients.
instructions: step_number: 1 instruction: Ensure your rice is cooked, cooled, and grains are separated. Leftover rice from the previous day is ideal. Prepare all vegetables: chop the onion, mince the garlic, dice the carrot, and roughly chop the dodo leaves. action: preparation ingredients: ing_cooked_rice, ing_dodo_leaves, ing_onion, ing_garlic, ing_carrot utensils: utn_knife_cutting_board

step_number: 2 instruction: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 2-3 minutes until softened. action: sautéing ingredients: ing_vegetable_oil, ing_onion utensils: utn_wok_large_skillet, utn_wooden_spoon_spatula

step_number: 3 instruction: Add the minced garlic and diced carrot. Stir-fry for 2 minutes until the garlic is fragrant and the carrot begins to soften. action: cooking_aromatics ingredients: ing_garlic, ing_carrot

step_number: 4 instruction: If using the egg, push the vegetables to one side of the wok. Pour the beaten egg into the empty space and scramble it until fully cooked, then mix it with the vegetables. action: adding_egg ingredients: ing_egg
step_number: 5 instruction: Add the chopped dodo leaves to the wok. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until the leaves are wilted. action: wilting_greens ingredients: ing_dodo_leaves

step_number: 6 instruction: Increase the heat to high. Add the cooled rice to the wok. Pour the soy sauce over the rice and add the salt and black pepper. action: adding_rice ingredients: ing_cooked_rice, ing_soy_sauce, ing_salt, ing_black_pepper

step_number: 7 instruction: Stir-fry everything together for 3-4 minutes, tossing constantly and breaking up any clumps of rice, until the rice is heated through and evenly coated with the seasonings. action: stir_frying cooking_indicators: visual: Rice is hot and grains are separate, vegetables are tender-crisp. time: 3-4 minutes texture: Fluffy rice with wilted but vibrant green dodo.
step_number: 8 instruction: Taste and adjust seasoning with more soy sauce or salt if needed. action: seasoning
step_number: 9 instruction: Remove from heat and garnish with chopped spring onions. action: garnishing ingredients: ing_spring_onion
step_number: 10 instruction: Serve the stir-fried dodo rice immediately while hot. action: serving

instructions: step_number: 1 instruction: Wash the collard greens thoroughly. Remove the tough central stem from each leaf. step_number: 6 instruction: Add the tomato paste and curry powder. Stir and cook for 1 minute. action: toasting_spices ingredients: ing_tomato_paste, ing_curry_powder

name: en: Waragi (Ugandan Gin) local_name: Waragi
description: A clear, potent, and traditional Ugandan spirit, often referred to as 'War Gin'. It is typically distilled from fermented bananas (musule), millet, or sugar cane. It has a strong, clean, and neutral taste, though flavor can vary by region and producer.
instructions: step_number: 1 instruction: WARNING: ILLEGAL AND EXTREMELY DANGEROUS. This information is for cultural understanding only. Do not attempt. The process involves creating toxic methanol and flammable vapors. Commercial production is the only safe source. action: warning details: Home distillation is illegal in Uganda and many countries due to the high risk of methanol poisoning, which causes blindness and death, as well as the risk of fire and explosion.

step_number: 2 instruction: Prepare the wash (the liquid to be fermented). For banana waragi (musule), ripe bananas are mashed and mixed with water. For millet waragi, millet is germinated, dried, and mixed with hot water to create a mash. action: preparing_wash ingredients: ing_base_ingredient, ing_water

step_number: 3 instruction: Add yeast to the mash to begin fermentation. The vessel is covered loosely and left in a warm place for several days to over a week. Natural wild yeast can also be used. action: fermentation ingredients: ing_yeast utensils: utn_fermentation_vessel cooking_indicators: visual: The mixture will bubble and produce a sour, alcoholic smell. time: 5-14 days

step_number: 4 instruction: DANGEROUS STEP: The fermented wash is transferred to a sealed metal drum over a very hot fire. A pipe or tube is attached to the drum's top, which runs through a cooling system (often a barrel of cold water) and into a collection vessel. action: distillation_setup utensils: utn_distillation_apparatus, utn_heat_source, utn_collection_vessel

step_number: 5 instruction: As the wash boils, alcohol vapors (which have a lower boiling point than water) rise, travel through the tube, condense back into liquid due to the cooling system, and drip into the collection vessel. The first portion of the distillate ('the heads') contains toxic methanol and is discarded by knowledgeable distillers. action: distillation cooking_indicators: visual: A clear liquid will begin to drip from the condenser tube. texture: The final product is a clear, high-proof spirit.

step_number: 6 instruction: The collected spirit is often diluted with water to achieve the desired alcohol percentage before being packaged for sale, typically in used plastic bottles or small, transparent plastic sachets. action: dilution_packaging ingredients: ing_water

Ingredients: White Rice (long grain) (2), Water (4), Carrots, diced (2), Green Beans, chopped (1), Sweet Corn Kernels (0.5), Green Peas (0.5), Green Bell Pepper, diced (1), Onion, finely chopped (1), Garlic, minced (2), Cooking Oil (2), Salt (1), Black Pepper (0.25), Chicken or Vegetable Stock (optional) (4), Spring Onions, chopped (2)

Cooking instructions: Step 1: step_number: 1 instruction: Rinse the white rice thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain well. action: rinsing_rice ingredients: ing_white_rice Step 2: step_number: 2 instruction: Prepare all vegetables: dice carrots, chop green beans, dice green pepper, chop onion, and mince garlic. action: preparing_vegetables ingredients: ing_carrots, ing_green_beans, ing_green_pepper, ing_onion, ing_garlic utensils: utn_knife, utn_cutting_board Step 3: step_number: 3 instruction: Heat cooking oil in a medium pot over medium heat. action: heating_oil ingredients: ing_cooking_oil utensils: utn_medium_pot Step 4: step_number: 4 instruction: Add chopped onion and sauté for 2-3 minutes until translucent. action: sauteing_onion ingredients: ing_onion Step 5: step_number: 5 instruction: Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. action: adding_garlic ingredients: ing_garlic Step 6: step_number: 6 instruction: Add the harder vegetables first: diced carrots and green beans. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly tender. action: cooking_hard_vegetables ingredients: ing_carrots, ing_green_beans Step 7: step_number: 7 instruction: Add the rinsed rice to the pot and stir to combine with the vegetables. action: adding_rice Step 8: step_number: 8 instruction: Pour in water or stock, then add salt and black pepper. Stir gently to combine. action: adding_liquid_seasoning ingredients: ing_water, ing_salt, ing_black_pepper, ing_chicken_vegetable_stock Step 9: step_number: 9 instruction: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover with a tight-fitting lid and simmer for 10 minutes. action: initial_simmering Step 10: step_number: 10 instruction: After 10 minutes, quickly add the remaining softer vegetables: green peas, sweet corn, and diced green pepper. Do not stir too much - just spread them evenly over the top. action: adding_soft_vegetables ingredients: ing_green_peas, ing_sweet_corn, ing_green_pepper Step 11: step_number: 11 instruction: Cover again and continue simmering for another 8-10 minutes until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed. action: final_simmering cooking_indicators: visual: The vegetables will become bright and vibrant in color olfactory: A fresh, vegetable-forward aroma will develop Step 12: step_number: 12 instruction: Remove from heat and let it stand covered for 5 minutes to allow the vegetables to steam and the rice to become fluffy. action: resting Step 13: step_number: 13 instruction: Gently fluff the rice with a fork, mixing the vegetables throughout. Be careful not to mash the vegetables. action: fluffing utensils: utn_wooden_spoon Step 14: step_number: 14 instruction: Stir in most of the chopped spring onions, reserving some for garnish. action: adding_garnish ingredients: ing_spring_onions Step 15: step_number: 15 instruction: Serve the colorful white vegetable rice hot, garnished with remaining spring onions. action: serving
